headline: Halfway Through October, Diesel Is Setting the Terms for the Entire Energy Market
summary: Oil Market Daily News Commentary - Global onshore oil inventories are hovering at their lowest levels since at least 2016, according to the International Energy Agency's October Oil Market Report, released on October 14. The agency estimates world oil supply rose 2.5 million barrels per day in September to 102.3 million barrels per day, led by Gulf producers, but described the recovery as fragile and said diesel markets remained under significant strain.
